brief_item.title: SmartGen: 选择性KV Cache传输加速PD分离推理
brief_item.core_conclusion: PD分离推理中节点间KV Cache传输挤占有限带宽、推高解码启动时延。SmartGen以三条协调通路重叠传输与计算，相比典型全量传输将第二token时延(TTST)降低4.3倍，后续解码精度保持可比。
brief_item.mechanism: 传输引擎三路协调：画像驱动路径在需求前推送关键KV条目；按需路径并行拉取远端/本地条目使解码在就绪子集上启动；投机路径投递剩余KV以保后续解码精度。
brief_item.result: 相比典型全量KV Cache传输，选择性三路传输实现4.3倍TTST降低(基线：典型全量传输；条件：选择性传输，解码精度可比)。
brief_item.boundary: 证据仅来自arXiv摘要，仅一个标题性比值，缺模型规模/带宽/绝对时延；关键条目选择方法与精度等价边界需全文验证。
brief_item.project_relevance: [项目判断]与KVCache跨节点传输方向高度契合，从调度重叠角度攻击PD传输瓶颈；投机传输路径是DPU/SmartNIC卸载的自然消费方；更低TTST利好多步Agent循环。

facts.title: SmartGen: Seamless Disaggregated LLM Inference with Selective KV Cache Transfer
facts.event_hint: A KV cache transfer engine for PD-disaggregated LLM serving that overlaps three transfer paths (proactive profile-based push, parallel on-demand fetch, speculative full delivery) to cut time-to-second-token by 4.3x.
facts.problem: Disaggregating prefill and decoding into separate node sets is widely adopted, but transferring enormous KV caches between disaggregated nodes easily saturates limited inter-node bandwidth, inflating the time before decoding can start.
facts.mechanism: KV cache transfer engine with three coordinated data paths: (1) a profile-based proactive transfer path that identifies and pushes essential KV cache entries before they are needed; (2) a parallel on-demand transfer path that fetches remote and local KV cache entries simultaneously so decode can begin on the ready subset; (3) a speculative transfer path that finally delivers all remaining KV cache, so subsequent decoding performance and accuracy are preserved.

evidence.claim: SmartGen achieves a 4.3x reduction in time-to-second-token compared to typical full KV cache transfer, while maintaining comparable subsequent decoding performance and accuracy.
evidence.condition: selective 3-path transfer, comparable decode accuracy retained

facts.evaluation_context: Abstract reports a single headline ratio (4.3x TTST) versus typical full transfer, with a stated guarantee that subsequent decode performance and accuracy remain comparable. No model, cluster, bandwidth, or absolute-latency specifics in the abstract.
facts.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; the single 4.3x figure lacks model/size, network bandwidth, and absolute-latency context. The essential-entry selection method and accuracy-equivalence bounds are pending full-text validation. Full paper body not fetched.
facts.project_relevance: Strongly relevant to the TPN / KVCache cross-node transfer track: it attacks the same PD transfer bottleneck as SpectrumKV and NetKV but from the scheduling/overlap angle (proactive + on-demand + speculative), which is the transfer-engine analog of parallel-speculative decoding and pairs with agent-acceleration goals (lower time-to-second-token improves multi-step agent loops). The speculative-transfer path is a natural consumer of DPU/SmartNIC-offloaded data movement.
